Anika: Quick shoutout — @Priya just saved the client demo at 9:42pm by hotfixing the rollout config and then appeared with banana bread. Absolute legend. :raised_hands: 
Priya: lol it was more of a duct-tape-on-fire situation, happy it worked out. also the banana bread was from my neighbour's recipe, take credit for the carbs not my config skills :blush:
Jules: that banana bread deserved its own release notes. 10/10, would accept PR. :banana::chef_kiss:
Samir: Can we make emergency-banana-bread-on-call an official incident response step? Asking for my stomach. :grin:
Luca: Adding Priya to the kudos board and tagging the demo thread. Also filing a tiny doc on the hotfix steps so we don't reverse-engineer at 3am next time.
ops-bot: Incident #2026-158 closed by Priya. Downtime: 12m. Notes: rollback avoided via config pin.
Anika: Filing a formal thank-you — team, please drop any emoji reactions here so I can screenshot for Priya. :trophy:
Jules: :trophy: :banana: :heart:
Samir: :clap: :clap:
Priya: thanks everyone, really appreciate it. extra slices in the kitchen for anyone who wants them (labelled vegan friendly).
Luca: Saved the demo, fed the team. New job title: CTO of Banana Bread. :laughing:
